1. RC Circuit Transient Troubleshooting Practice I
OBJECTIVES
. The experiment in this lesson is not setup to use the selected trainer.
EQUIPMENT REQUIRED
Nida Experiment Card PC130 - 14A
INTRODUCTIONM
In this lesson, you will determine if an RC transient circuit is faulted and if so, what the fault is.
The oscilloscope is used to determine if the circuit is operating correctly by observing the waveform across the resistor.
The wave form measurement will indicate several probable faults such as an open capacitor or a shorted resistor.
In some cases, resistance measurements are necessary to determine the faulty component.
Let's begin the lesson on RC CIRCUIT TRANSIENT TROUBLESHOOTING PRACTICE I.
. The experiment in this lesson is not setup to use the selected trainer.

EXPERIMENT
The purpose of this experiment is to give you practice in determining if an RC transient circuit is operating normally and if not, to determine the faulty component.
Pick up the PC130-14A card. This card is used to practice troubleshooting RC circuit transients.
Compare the card with the schematic shown.
Notice that there are four series RC circuits on the card with different RC time constants.
Circuit D will not be used in this troubleshooting practice. Let's set up the Test Console and the card before troubleshooting...
